news.headline: RECORD FLOOD CONTINUES INTO THU EVENING — NWS Melbourne: Flood Warning for southeastern Brevard until 6 PM Thu, Flash Flood Warning until 5 PM and Flood Warnings until 7 PM, Wind Advisory until 7 PM; Flood Watch for Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Volusia, Brevard & most of east-central Florida through Fri Nov 20 7 PM; St. Johns River near Cocoa at 18.0 ft at 5:15 AM Thu, above the flood of record (flood stage 16 ft), forecast to stay above record levels through late week/weekend — 3–6 in. of rain forecast, isolated 8–12 in.

Central Florida build costs eased in November — RoMac Whole House Commodity Index fell 1.1% to $53,443 (down $594), lumber driving the drop, but manufacturers have already announced January price increases and diesel is more than 50% above last year; Florida October single-family closings fell 10.1% from a year earlier to 19,049, with pending sales down 15.7%

U.S. housing starts rose 9.9% in October to 1.309 million annual rate — single-family starts up 4.0% to 864,000 — but building permits fell 7.4% to 1.295 million, with single-family permits down 8.7% to 772,000, lowest since January 2023; builder confidence fell 4 points to 25 in November, lowest since April 2012, with 46% of builders cutting prices

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules

Copper holds near seven-month low Thu afternoon — Comex copper $5.61/lb at 3:26 PM ET Nov 19, down 0.96%; LME copper lowest since April amid strong dollar and AI-demand doubts; North American clean copper scrap fell 31¢/lb in the Nov 18 session, down 60¢/lb since Nov 11

Regency Electric acquires Tekline Electrical Services of Chandler, AZ — deal closed Nov 3, terms undisclosed, expanding the Colorado commercial electrical contractor into Arizona; Tekline serves manufacturing, healthcare, education, hospitality and industrial markets

Fed minutes released Wed Nov 18 read hawkish — almost all October FOMC participants judged further rate hikes likely in months ahead to return inflation to 2%; funds held at 3.75–4.00%, next meeting Dec 8–9, markets pricing ~95% odds of a December hike and JPMorgan on Nov 19 added January and March 2027 hikes to its call, seeing 4.50–4.75% by March; S&P 500 fell 0.23% Wed to 7,323.63 for a fifth straight loss
Florida workers' comp: Commissioner Yaworsky approved NCCI's −7.4% average rate cut for new and renewal policies from Jan 1, 2027 — 11th straight year of reductions

NBA Wed: Heat 137, Bucks 130 — Giannis Antetokounmpo 27 pts, 13 reb, 9 ast in his first game vs. his former team, Miami's 6th straight win; 76ers 121, Magic 116 — Franz Wagner 27 pts & 11 ast for Orlando; Magic next at Brooklyn Fri Nov 20

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Buccaneers (3-6) at Lions (7-2) 1 PM ET, Dolphins at Bills 1 PM ET, Jaguars (7-2) at Giants 4:25 PM ET; Bucs QB Baker Mayfield returned to practice Thu after missing Wed with a foot injury and says he's ready to go — head coach Todd Bowles' decision expected Fri
